decisions.source_text: Kshana Thunder type slash attack on a single enemy x4 (S) and stack Dragon Echo on user When in a Thundering stance : Skill Multiplier +300% (Multiplier x4) and user and allies to the left and right of user Gain Shield with HP equal to 30% of their Max HP (3 turns) Shield HP gets depleted before user HP and cannot be restored Slash  Active Skills

decisions.reviewer_notes: can deploy and awaken zone at the same time, with condition where this hero must be SA and there are 4+ Earth characters in front lines. Awaken zone can only be activated once per battle
decisions.source_text: Battle Start Awakened Earth Zone Battle Start When user is in the front line : Inflict Expose (Earth) on all enemies (Current turn only) Exposed : Inflict Weakness to enemy (does not override null or absorb) When there are 4+ Earth characters in the front lines: Deploy Torn Earth Stance Once per battle: awaken Another Zone ( 3 turns ) Stack 30 Rustbane Skill requires Stellar Awakening Passive  Stellar Awakened Skills
